data.revised_prompt: Single centered full-body reference sprite of a Codex app digital pet named Tracebun: a compact observability guardian rabbit inspired by SanguiShop, warm brown and cream colors, sturdy chibi silhouette, thick dark 1-2 px outline, visible stepped/pixel edges, limited palette, flat cel shading with at most one small highlight and one shadow step, simple readable face with calm focused eyes, small floppy ears, tiny service badge on the chest, reliable engineer energy, patient trustworthy detail-oriented expression. Pixel-art-adjacent low-resolution mascot sprite, chunky whole-body silhouette, tiny limbs, designed to remain readable at 192x208. Pose: neutral standing pose, front-facing or slight 3/4 view, full body fully visible and centered. Perfectly flat pure magenta #FF00FF chroma-key background. No scenery, no text, no borders, no checkerboard transparency, no detached effects, no shadows/glows, no extra props. Avoid polished illustration, painterly rendering, anime key art, 3D render, vector app-icon polish, glossy lighting, soft gradients, realistic fur/material texture, anti-aliased high-detail edges, and complex tiny accessories. Do not use magenta or near-magenta colors in the pet, badge, highlights, or effects.
